# build2 Ecosystem -- AI Reference

> Structured, AI-consumable reference for the build2 C/C++ toolchain: build
> system (b), package manager (bpkg), and project manager (bdep).

## Start here

- [SKILL.md](SKILL.md): Skill entry point -- activation hints, when-to-use table, quick orientation.
- [INDEX.md](INDEX.md): Ecosystem overview, full command lookup tables, and navigation links to all reference files. Read this first.
- [GLOSSARY.md](GLOSSARY.md): Cross-tool terminology.

## Tool references

- [b/README.md](b/README.md): Build system driver -- buildspec syntax, meta-operations, operations, key options.
- [b/b.md](b/b.md): Full b option reference.
- [bpkg/README.md](bpkg/README.md): Package manager -- key concepts, all commands, typical workflows.
- [bdep/README.md](bdep/README.md): Project dependency manager -- key concepts, all commands, typical workflows.
- [bx/README.md](bx/README.md): Shell script and task runner reference.

## Guides

- [guides/packaging-guide-summary.md](guides/packaging-guide-summary.md): Third-party packaging guide -- concepts, workflow checklist, and steps 1-7 (repository setup through installation configuration).
- [guides/packaging-guide-testing.md](guides/packaging-guide-testing.md): Third-party packaging -- steps 8-10: writing tests, CI validation, releasing and publishing to cppget.org, common pitfalls.
- [guides/packaging-guide-review.md](guides/packaging-guide-review.md): Third-party package review process -- transition policy, initial/version/revision review procedures, authoritative checklist, outcome and email formats.
- [guides/build2-intro-concepts.md](guides/build2-intro-concepts.md): build2 concepts -- targets, scopes, modules, variables, operations.
- [guides/build2-buildfile-language.md](guides/build2-buildfile-language.md): Buildfile language reference -- syntax, directives, conditions, loops, out-of-source builds.
- [guides/build2-directives-patterns.md](guides/build2-directives-patterns.md): Buildfile directives (define, using, import, include, source, if/for/while, assert, run, dump) plus name wildcard patterns and target/variable attributes.
- [guides/build2-projects-advanced.md](guides/build2-projects-advanced.md): Advanced projects -- importation, library metadata, testing, installation, subprojects, diagnostics.
- [guides/build2-modules-bin.md](guides/build2-modules-bin.md): bin module -- binary target type hierarchy (lib, liba, libs, exe, obj, bmi).
- [guides/build2-modules-cc.md](guides/build2-modules-cc.md): cc module -- C-common infrastructure, DLL export, compilation database, toolchain detection.
- [guides/build2-modules-c.md](guides/build2-modules-c.md): c module -- C compilation, Objective-C, assembler.
- [guides/build2-modules-cxx.md](guides/build2-modules-cxx.md): cxx module -- C++ compilation, C++20 modules, cross-compilation, options reference.
- [guides/build2-modules-core.md](guides/build2-modules-core.md): Core modules reference -- config (hermetic builds), test (config.test, runners), install (layout, filtering, relocation).
- [guides/build2-module-version.md](guides/build2-module-version.md): version module -- version variables, integer encoding, snapshot versions, version header generation from .in templates.
- [guides/build2-project-config.md](guides/build2-project-config.md): Project configuration system.
- [guides/build2-targets-variables.md](guides/build2-targets-variables.md): Target types and variable reference.
- [guides/testscript-summary.md](guides/testscript-summary.md): Testscript language reference -- integration, execution model, lexical structure, test/group scopes, commands.
- [guides/testscript-commands.md](guides/testscript-commands.md): Testscript variables, redirections, here-documents, output regex, cleanup, builtins table, and common patterns.
- [guides/build2-modules-autoconf.md](guides/build2-modules-autoconf.md): autoconf module -- processing config.h.in/cmake/meson files with builtin and project checks.
- [guides/build2-autoconf-project-checks.md](guides/build2-autoconf-project-checks.md): autoconf module -- authoring project-specific checks in build/autoconf/checks/.
- [guides/build2-autoconf-buildfile.md](guides/build2-autoconf-buildfile.md): autoconf module -- communicating check results to buildfiles via c.predefs.
- [guides/build2-autoconf-contributing-checks.md](guides/build2-autoconf-contributing-checks.md): autoconf module -- stylistic guidelines and PR format for contributing checks to the builtin catalog.
- [guides/kconfig-summary.md](guides/kconfig-summary.md): kconfig module -- overview, enabling, and full Kconfig language reference (config entries, dependencies, menus, choices).
- [guides/kconfig-integration.md](guides/kconfig-integration.md): kconfig build system integration -- loading files, generated config, module variables, and complete worked example.
- [guides/install-bootstrap.md](guides/install-bootstrap.md): Installing and bootstrapping -- prerequisites, pre-built packages, and bootstrap steps 1-2 (all platforms).
- [guides/install-toolchain.md](guides/install-toolchain.md): Toolchain install step 3 -- stage, create bpkg configuration, install from repository, add modules, clean.
- [guides/install-upgrade.md](guides/install-upgrade.md): Upgrading an installed toolchain -- dirty upgrade (patch), staged upgrade (minor/major), recreating the bpkg configuration, default paths.

## HOWTO

- [HOWTO/README.md](HOWTO/README.md): Practical recipes indexed by topic.
- [HOWTO/troubleshooting.md](HOWTO/troubleshooting.md): Common error messages and resolutions for b, bpkg, and bdep.
- [HOWTO/alias-targets.md](HOWTO/alias-targets.md): PHONY-equivalent targets using alias{}.
- [HOWTO/buildfile-compile-options.md](HOWTO/buildfile-compile-options.md): Which compile/link options belong in a buildfile.
- [HOWTO/config-independent-build-graph.md](HOWTO/config-independent-build-graph.md): Keeping the build graph configuration-independent.
- [HOWTO/for-install-conflicts.md](HOWTO/for-install-conflicts.md): Resolving "already updated but [not] for install" errors.
- [HOWTO/generated-headers.md](HOWTO/generated-headers.md): Auto-generated C/C++ headers.
- [HOWTO/disable-shared-lib-per-platform.md](HOWTO/disable-shared-lib-per-platform.md): Disabling the shared library variant per platform.
- [HOWTO/header-only-library.md](HOWTO/header-only-library.md): Binless (header-only) libraries.
- [HOWTO/library-provides-main.md](HOWTO/library-provides-main.md): Library that provides main().
- [HOWTO/link-pthread.md](HOWTO/link-pthread.md): Linking pthread.
- [HOWTO/link-system-library.md](HOWTO/link-system-library.md): Linking system libraries (-lm, -ldl, advapi32.lib).
- [HOWTO/optional-library-components.md](HOWTO/optional-library-components.md): Making library components optional.
- [HOWTO/target-metadata.md](HOWTO/target-metadata.md): Exporting metadata with executables and libraries.
- [HOWTO/assert-in-tests.md](HOWTO/assert-in-tests.md): Correctly using assert() in tests.
- [HOWTO/sanitize-tests.md](HOWTO/sanitize-tests.md): Sanitizing misbehaving tests with Testscript.
- [HOWTO/tests-extra-dependencies.md](HOWTO/tests-extra-dependencies.md): Tests with extra dependencies (separate test package).
- [HOWTO/convert-source-to-utf8.md](HOWTO/convert-source-to-utf8.md): Converting source file encoding to UTF-8.
- [HOWTO/package-naming.md](HOWTO/package-naming.md): Naming packages for third-party projects.
- [HOWTO/package-version-non-semver.md](HOWTO/package-version-non-semver.md): Projects that don't use semantic versioning.
- [HOWTO/package-version-none.md](HOWTO/package-version-none.md): Projects with no version at all.
- [HOWTO/multiple-configurations.md](HOWTO/multiple-configurations.md): Managing debug/release/sanitize configurations with bdep.
- [HOWTO/cross-compilation.md](HOWTO/cross-compilation.md): Setting up a cross-compilation configuration with target triplets.
- [HOWTO/ci-cd-setup.md](HOWTO/ci-cd-setup.md): Typical CI pipeline using bdep update/test.
- [HOWTO/migrate-from-cmake.md](HOWTO/migrate-from-cmake.md): Porting a CMake project to build2 buildfiles.
- [HOWTO/toolchain-dev-setup.md](HOWTO/toolchain-dev-setup.md): Setting up build2 for toolchain development.

## Scripts

- [scripts/verify-install.sh](scripts/verify-install.sh): Verify build2 toolchain installation.
- [scripts/new-package.sh](scripts/new-package.sh): Scaffold a new bpkg package directory.
- [scripts/probe-compiler.sh](scripts/probe-compiler.sh): Scan PATH for C++ compilers; print family, target triplet, and version.
- [scripts/check-manifest.sh](scripts/check-manifest.sh): Validate a bpkg manifest for required and recommended fields.
- [scripts/run-tests.sh](scripts/run-tests.sh): Run bpkg test --all in a bpkg configuration directory.
- [scripts/show-project-info.sh](scripts/show-project-info.sh): Display b info output in a labeled, consistent format.

## Raw source

- [build2-toolchain/](build2-toolchain/): Git submodule containing the upstream .cli source files. Run init-docs.sh to extract them to .docs/.
- [build2-howto/](build2-howto/): Git submodule containing the upstream HOWTO entries. Run init-docs.sh to extract them to .docs/HOWTO/.
